observations: body L2, L3: the kasra under the final nūn of «المَطَالِعَيْنِ» (L2) stands 5.7 points below the baseline, just above the a of «ac» (L3); «ac» has no accent.
body L4, L14, L15, L16: «المَطَالِعُ» (L4), «وَسَط» (L14), «البروج» (L15) and «الأوْتاد» (L16) are printed with elongated joins (kashīda), not transcribed.

body L5, L9: in a) the gloss «(vel مطالع البروج)» follows «في الفَلَك المُسْتَقِيم» (L5); in b) (L9) the print sets it inside the Arabic phrase, between «المطالع» (right) and «في الإِقْلِيم» (left); its parentheses stand at 334.4 and 403.7 points. Transcribed in reading order.
body L5: «في الفَلَك المُسْتَقِيم» has no vowel sign on the kāf and on the final mīm. «ὀρϑῆς» is printed with the omicron sort whose head turns left (smooth breathing) and with ϑ, as on p. 330.
body L6, L9: the alif after the article of «الٱسْتِوَاء» (L6) carries the waṣla; «الإِقْلِيم» (L9) has the hamza below the alif with a kasra under it, a sukūn on the qāf and a kasra under the lām.
body L7, L16: «تتوسّط» (L7) has the shadda alone and «السماء» no vowel sign. The alif of «الأوْتاد» (L16) carries a plain hamza without a vowel, and «ارْباع» has no hamza.

body L14, L24: the sign above the shadda of the sīn of «التَّوَسُّط» (L14) and of the ṭāʾ of «الطُّولِ» (L24) is the flattened damma (a round head with a tail); above the tāʾ of «التَّوَسُّط» it is a fatḥa.
body L15, L22: the first digit of «٢١» (L15) and the last digit of «١٦٢» (L22) have one crest each (a 2).
body L19: over «الزَّوَال» the fatḥa above the shadda of the zāy and the fatḥa of the wāw are joined by a thin stroke; the sign above the shadda of «القُبَّة» is a fatḥa.
body L23: the final hamza of «جُزْءٌ» is the sort with the dammatān (4.7 by 5.6 points).

body L25, L26, L28: the headword «ظِلّ» (L26) has a kasra under the ẓāʾ. Over the shadda of every «ظِلٌّ» of L26 and L28 the dammatān is printed as two small loops side by side. «ثانٍ» has no fatḥa: the stroke above the thāʾ is the descender of the p of «persaepe» in L25.
body L27, L30: «٣٢» (L27, L30) has a first digit with two crests (a 3) and a second with one crest (a 2); both digits of «٣٣» (L30) have two crests.
body L28, L30: «181-182» (L28) is printed with a hyphen (3.5 points), «181–182» (L30) with an en dash (5.0 points); transcribed as printed.
body L29: the alif of «أوَّل» carries a plain hamza (3.4 by 3.1 points, its counter open) without a vowel; the wāw has the shadda with a fatḥa. The second «ظلّ» of the line has no kasra.
body L33: «viii» is printed in small capitals, the «I» of «v. I» in a full capital.
notes_left L2: the Persian «شمس» is printed with an elongated join (kashīda), not transcribed; «مطلعى» ends in a yāʾ without dots, as on p. 335.
notes_left L7: «192–193» is printed with an en dash (4.7 points); the hyphens of the notes measure 2.6-2.8 points.
notes_right L2: «καϑόλου» is printed with ϑ.
